sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 255 was established by Ordinance No. 19345, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 29, 1986. Ordinance No. 19345 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 255 is established on property generally fronting on the south line of Walnut Street, west of the west line of Plano Road. The size of PD 255 is approximately 7.589 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 255A). The development plan serves as the detailed development plan for Tract B. A detailed development plan for Tract A must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit on that tract. The detailed development plan must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51-4.803(d). In deciding whether to approve or deny the development plan, the city plan commission shall follow the standards set out for the director of development services in Section 51- 4.803. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.105. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property by tract are as follows:

(1) Tract A. Mini-warehouse and those uses permitted in an SC Shopping Center District as set forth in the Dallas Development Code, excluding residential uses. The caretakers unit, permitted as an accessory use to the mini-warehouse, is designated as “apt.” on the development plan.

(2) Tract B. Mini-warehouse, office, and vehicular storage. For purposes of this article, vehicular storage is defined as open storage of operable motor vehicles or boats. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.106. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be installed as shown on the development plan and ground cover must be installed in accordance with Section 51P-255.111 before issuance of any certificate of occupancy on the Property. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking on the Property must be provided in accordance with the provisions of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.108. PAVING.

All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must be surfaced to comply with the standards set out in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.109. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. No non-premise signs are permitted, except that non-premise signs displaying noncommercial messages are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Hours Of Operation For Mini-Warehouse
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.110. HOURS OF OPERATION FOR MINI-WAREHOUSE.

The only permitted hours of operation for the mini-warehouse facility are from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.111. SETBACKS.

Minimum setback of 25 feet must be maintained along the boundary of the Property adjacent to Walnut Street and along the western boundary of the Property, designated on the development plan as landscaped area. Only ground cover consisting of natural plant materials is permitted in the 25-foot setback along the western boundary of the Property. All other setbacks in Tract B must comply with the development plan. Setbacks on Tract A must comply with the Shopping Center District setback requirements. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.112. SCREENING.

A six-foot-high solid screening wall must be provided as shown on the development plan and permanently maintained. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.113. HEIGHT.

Maximum heights on the Property by tract are as follows:

(1) Tract A. No structure may exceed the heights permitted in an SC Shopping Center District, as designated in the Dallas Development Code.

(2) Tract B. Maximum height for the caretaker’s unit and office is 14 feet. Maximum height for all other structures is 12 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.114. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted lot coverage is 40 percent. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Utilization of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this ordinance, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-255.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 255 is located on Zoning Map No. D-10. (Ord. Nos. 19345; 25711)
